name: cuba-mongoose-cuba-project.pdf
description: Declassified 1998 JFK Records Act identification form for a 1962 TOP SECRET, 24-page memorandum on Operation Mongoose and "The Cuba Project" (dated 01/18/62), reviewed by Brig. Gen. E. G. Lansdale, covering U.S. plans to spur an internal Cuban revolt and the intelligence, political, and military tasks due February 1962.
